title: convolution1dLayer
summary: Create a 1-D convolution layer compatibility object.
behaviors: `Stride` defaults to `1`; `Padding` defaults to zero on both sides. Set `Padding` to `same` or `causal` explicitly to use those modes.
Common convolution name-value options are preserved as properties.

example.input:
layer = convolution1dLayer(filterSize, numFilters)
layer = convolution1dLayer(filterSize, numFilters, Name, Value)

gpu_residency: Layer construction is host metadata work. Host network execution uses the convolution kernel; explicit resident inputs are not silently gathered into that host route.
